reportTemplate.summary: Opened the Sales Orders list and applied a read-only Customer Name filter (like %{{v1}}%), which returned exactly 3 orders, all starting with "{{v1}}". Each name was read off the list rows and re-verified on the order's own detail page (title heading / Customer link): SAL-ORD-2026-00001 = "{{v1}} Alpha Traders", {{d2}} = "{{v1}} Beacon Supplies", {{d1}} = "{{v1}} Cobalt Retail". The list's page-size controls showed the row-limit options 20 / 100 / 500 / 2500 (default 20), so all 3 results were on one page. No order was edited, saved or submitted.
